pairs: But there was a man related to Elimelech,
Dixitque Ruth Moabitis ad socrum suam:
And Ruth, the Moabite, said to her mother-in-law,
vadam in agrum, et colligam spicas quæ fugerint manus metentium,
I will go into the field and gather the ears of grain which escape the reaping hand,
ubicumque clementis in me patrisfamilias reperero gratiam.
wherever I will find favor with the father of a family, who will be compassionate to me.”
Abiit itaque et colligebat spicas post terga metentium.
And so she went and gathered the ears of grain after the completion of the reaping.
Accidit autem ut ager ille haberet dominum nomine Booz,
But it happened that this field was owned by Boaz,
who was of the kindred of Elimelech.
Dixitque Booz juveni, qui messoribus præerat:
And Boaz said to the young man who was in charge of the reapers,
from the land of the Moabites,
et rogavit ut spicas colligeret remanentes,
and she asked to gather the remnants of the ears of grain,
following the steps of the reapers,
et de mane usque nunc stat in agro,
and from morning until now she has remained in the field,
et ne ad momentum quidem domum reversa est.
and, indeed, not for one moment has she returned home.”
ne vadas in alterum agrum ad colligendum,
Do not go to gather in any other field,
but join with my young women,
For I have given orders to my young men,
so that no one is to harass you.
And so, whenever you are thirsty,
et bibe aquas, de quibus et pueri bibunt.
and drink from the waters that the young men also drink.”
Quæ cadens in faciem suam et adorans super terram,
She, falling on her face and paying homage on the ground,
dixit ad eum: Unde mihi hoc,
said to him: “How did this happen to me,
ut invenirem gratiam ante oculos tuos,
that I should find favor before your eyes,
et nosse me dignareris peregrinam mulierem?
and that you would condescend to accept me, a foreign woman?”
Nuntiata sunt mihi omnia quæ feceris socrui tuæ post mortem viri tui:
what things you have done for your mother-in-law after the death of your husband,
et terram in qua nata es,
and how you left your parents,
and the land in which you were born,
and came to a people you did not know before.
Reddat tibi Dominus pro opere tuo,
May the Lord repay you for your work,
et plenam mercedem recipias a Domino Deo Israël,
and may you receive a full reward from the Lord, the God of Israel,
and under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
“I have found favor before your eyes,
et locutus es ad cor ancillæ tuæ,
and you have spoken to the heart of your handmaid,
quæ non sum similis unius puellarum tuarum.
who is unlike one of your young women.”
et intinge buccellam tuam in aceto.
and dip your morsel in the vinegar.”
And so she sat beside the reapers,
and she piled up parched grain for herself,
and she ate and was satisfied,
And then she arose from there,
so as to gather the ears of grain,
Præcepit autem Booz pueris suis, dicens:
according to the custom. But Boaz commanded his servants,
saying, “If she is even willing to reap with you,
et de vestris quoque manipulis projicite de industria,
and purposely let fall some from your bundles,
so that she may gather without blushing,
and let no one rebuke her gathering.”
Collegit ergo in agro usque ad vesperam:
And so she gathered in the field until evening.
et quæ collegerat virga cædens et excutiens,
And striking and threshing with a staff what she had gathered,
she found about the measure of an ephah of barley,
Quos portans reversa est in civitatem,
she returned into the city and showed it to her mother-in-law.
et dedit ei de reliquiis cibi sui,
she offered it to her and even gave her the leftovers of her food,
with which she had been satisfied.
And her mother-in-law said to her,
and where have you found work?
sit benedictus qui misertus est tui.
Blessed is he who took pity on you!”
Indicavitque ei apud quem fuisset operata:
And she informed her with whom she had been working,
and she said the man’s name,
“May he be blessed by the Lord,
quoniam eamdem gratiam, quam præbuerat vivis,
because the same kindness which he provided for the living,
he also kept for the dead.”
ut tamdiu messoribus ejus jungerer, donec omnes segetes meterentur.
that from now on I should join with his reapers until all the crop has been reaped.”
And her mother-in-law said to her,
ut cum puellis ejus exeas ad metendum,
to go out reaping with his young women,
ne in alieno agro quispiam resistat tibi.
lest in a stranger’s field someone may confront you.”
she joined with the young women of Boaz,
and from then on reaped with them,
until the barley and the wheat were stored in the barns.
